experiment.name: isolated guarded bulk syndrome cycle
experiment.fault_model: all 15 nonidentity two-qubit Pauli outcomes after each CNOT in the noisy round

lower_bound.method: exact pair meet-in-the-middle over detector and logical signatures
lower_bound.collision_handling: Every equal-hash bucket is regrouped by the complete 384-bit detector signature before logical signatures are compared; hash collisions cannot change the result.

upper_bound.method: six data-only Pauli outcomes, one after the final CNOT touching each qubit of a stored minimum logical

symmetry_check: The schedule is mapped to itself by the code's ZX fold plus time reversal; the lower bound was nevertheless computed independently in both memory bases.
scope_note: This certifies fault distance at least five for the stated CNOT-only guarded-bulk model. Exact distance is either five or six. It is not a full hardware-noise memory threshold result.
